input.quote: 13.1 Term. This Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and, unless terminated earlier pursuant to this Article 13, shall continue in full force and effect, on a Product-by-Product and country-by-country basis until the Secondary Royalty Term with respect to such Product expires, at which time this Agreement shall expire in its entirety with respect to such Product in such country.
input.rationale: The auto-renewal mechanics this rule targets are not used in this agreement. Section 13.1 sets a single, self-liquidating term running from the Effective Date until expiry of the Secondary Royalty Term on a Product-by-Product/country-by-country basis; there is no automatic renewal, no successive renewal term, and therefore no non-renewal notice window or renewal price uplift to compute (a document-wide search for "renew"/renewal-term language returns only patent-term renewals and Section 14.4, which expressly disclaims any renewal or extension by conduct). The structure is better than the preferred position for us: on expiry the Section 2.1 licences convert to perpetual, irrevocable, fully paid-up, royalty-free licences to Ono, and Section 13.2 gives Ono (not Array) a without-cause termination right on advance notice. No renewal exit or pricing exposure arises, so no redline is warranted.
